Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 5 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: rectangular wood dining table, 198 cm wide, 102 cm deep, 76 cm high
image 3: upholstered dining chair, set of two, 66 cm wide, 53 cm deep, 103 cm high, 3 units
image 4: drum shade pendant chandelier, 51 cm wide, 51 cm deep, 107 cm high
image 5: four-door buffet sideboard, 173 cm wide, 51 cm deep, 82 cm high

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "En este espacio abierto, entre la cocina y la escalera, quiero el comedor: una mesa de madera oscura para seis u ocho personas, sillas tapizadas en tela gris, una lámpara colgante grande sobre la mesa y un aparador de madera contra la pared de la escalera. Clásico pero actual, cálido.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
